ns2:course.label: ZooMed: What is Your Diagnosis
ns2:course.description: A series of interactive, non-domestic animal cases will be discusses during each meeting. Expands a veterinary student's confidence and diagnostic skill when working with these species. No graduate credit. 1 professional hour. Approved for Letter and S/U grading.
